candidates.title: Telangana Assembly declares Khairatabad seat vacant following Danam Nagender disqualification
candidates.excerpt: The Telangana Assembly has issued a gazette notification declaring the Khairatabad seat vacant following the disqualification of Danam Nagender. The Telangana High Court had disqualified him with effect from April 23, 2024, a decision later upheld by the Supreme Court.

candidates.title: CMC accelerates H-CITI flyover, underpass works in Gachibowli
candidates.excerpt: The CMC has accelerated H-CITI flyover and underpass works at IIIT Junction and Khajaguda after completing earth excavation at Gachibowli Junction. Officials said 40 per cent of civil works was complete, with pillar and beam construction progressing towards 2027 deadlines.

candidates.title: JNTU-Sulthanpur students protest alleged ragging, block NH-161
candidates.excerpt: Second-year students of JNTU-Sulthanpur in Sangareddy staged a protest alleging harassment and ragging by third-year students. The students blocked NH-161, demanding action against those responsible and urging the police and management to curb ragging on the campus.
